items.title: Bill and payment are distinct concepts
items.statement: A bill/invoice records an amount due; a payment records value received against one or more obligations.
items.revalidation_trigger: Project billing terminology or accounting policy differs.

items.title: Historical billing records need traceability
items.statement: Historical account statements and payment history should preserve source period, adjustments, backdating, reconciliation status, and audit trail.
items.revalidation_trigger: Billing period, adjustment, or audit policy changes.

items.title: Billing test pattern
items.statement: Billing tests should include bill creation, partial payment, adjustment, arrears, backdating, historical statement view, and reconciliation checks.
items.revalidation_trigger: Billing lifecycle or adjustment rules change.

items.title: Billing document extraction terms
items.statement: Billing document analysis should treat account, bill, payment, adjustment, arrears, meter, billing cycle, and reconciliation terms as extraction hints, not final classification.
items.revalidation_trigger: Billing terminology or document template changes.
